summary: Frontend-only regression after adding /app/frontend/src/lib/dngXmp.js and its import in AutoBasic.jsx. Seeded a session cookie (session_token, httpOnly/secure/SameSite=None) and visited /auto-basic, /dashboard, /styles, /learning, /engine-lab, /profiles on the public preview URL. All routes returned HTTP 200 and rendered. /auto-basic shows heading 'Auto básicos → XMP', empty-state, and all required data-testids: autobasic-pick-folder-btn, autobasic-mode-conservative/balanced/aggressive, autobasic-profile-input, autobasic-empty. Nav 'Auto XMP' (nav-autobasic-btn) is present and correctly navigates to /auto-basic. Mode switch click and camera-profile input edit work (value updates to 'Camera Neutral'). No JS runtime errors and no pageerror events; no console errors attributable to the new dngXmp import. The only console noise was a handful of ERR_CONNECTION_CLOSED entries for external resource fetches (unrelated to app JS). Folder upload / DNG embedding was intentionally NOT exercised (per request; covered by jest unit tests 3/3).
critical_code_review_comments: AutoBasic.jsx exportZip swallows embedXmpInDng errors with an empty `catch {}` (line 59). Falling back to a sidecar is fine, but at minimum log to console.warn or surface a toast so DNG-embed regressions are noticeable — otherwise a broken embed silently degrades to sidecars, which is the exact bug this feature is trying to fix.
isDng is duplicated (defined locally in AutoBasic.jsx and likely useful elsewhere). Consider exporting it from src/lib/dngXmp.js alongside embedXmpInDng for DRY.
The input attributes `webkitdirectory="" directory=""` should be `webkitdirectory directory` (boolean); React may warn on non-standard DOM attribute casing. Not blocking.
